data.body: Follow-up change 3536 merged as 6ec30637b90 at 06:32 PST 2026-11-23 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). make verify before push: 21913 passed / 34 skipped default tier, 231 passed / 2 skipped integration tier. One remaining LLM-Review advisory, accepted as is: a proxy 408/429 now stays retryable via the status-less ModelAPIError -> RETRY_NOW arm, so its message reads 'Transient connection blip' rather than the WAIT_AND_RETRY backoff text. It is retryable either way, which is the behaviour that matters, and it is exactly the pre-change behaviour for that answer. Acceptance criteria met: the AC test (2-leg FallbackExceptionGroup of ModelAPIError <- APIConnectionError <- httpx.ProxyError 403) asserts CHANGE_SETTINGS, non-retryable, with the proxy-naming message; ConnectError/ConnectTimeout keep RETRY_NOW.
